info.name: PickAm Backend — MVP
info.description:
Complete API collection for the PickAm delivery platform backend.

**Services:**
- API Gateway: http://localhost:3000
- User Service: http://localhost:3001
- Wallet Service: http://localhost:3002
- Order Service: http://localhost:3003
- Notification Service: http://localhost:3004
- Admin Service: http://localhost:3005

**SafeHaven Sandbox:** https://api.sandbox.safehavenmfb.com

**Auth:** All protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header.
Run the Login request first — the test script will auto-set `accessToken`.

item.name: Cancel Order
item.description:
⚠️ Cancellation Rules:
- Only orders in PENDING or ASSIGNED status can be cancelled.
- Orders in PICKED_UP or DELIVERED status CANNOT be cancelled.
- A full wallet refund is automatically processed on successful cancellation.
- The assigned rider (if any) is notified automatically.

response.name: 400 — Cannot Cancel (Already PICKED_UP)
403 — Forbidden (Not Your Order)

item.name: Get Order History (Paginated)
item.description:
Returns paginated orders for the current user. Admins see all orders. Riders see their own.

**Query Parameters:**
- `page` — Page number (default: 1)
- `limit` — Results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `search` — Search by order ID, recipient name/phone, or address
- `status` — Filter: PENDING | ASSIGNED | PICKED_UP | DELIVERED | CANCELLED
- `paymentStatus` — Filter: PAID | REFUNDED
- `sort` — Sort field (default: createdAt)
- `order` — ASC | DESC (default: desc)
- `startDate` — Date range start (ISO 8601)
- `endDate` — Date range end (ISO 8601)

query.description: Search by order ID, recipient name/phone

item.name: 🏍️ Get Available Orders (Riders)
item.description:
Returns paginated list of PENDING orders that have not been accepted by any rider. **Riders only.**

Riders can filter by pickup zone and search by address. Only non-expired orders are shown.

item.name: 🏍️ Accept Order (Rider Self-Assign)
item.description:
A rider accepts a PENDING order and becomes the assigned rider. Uses a database transaction to prevent race conditions (two riders accepting the same order simultaneously).

**Riders only.** No request body needed — the rider's identity is taken from the auth token.

**Error cases:**
- 404: Order not found
- 400: Order already accepted by another rider
- 400: Order has expired

item.name: 👥 Admin — User Management
item.description:
Complete admin user management: list, view, update role/privileges, suspend, activate, soft-delete, and view user wallet/orders.

**Admin Privileges Required:**
- `SUPER_ADMIN` (Full Access)
- `USER_MANAGEMENT` (User query, update, suspend, activate)
- `SUPPORT` (User view & order history)
- `FINANCE` (User wallet inspection)

**Pagination Pattern (all list endpoints):**
```
GET /admin/users?page=1&limit=20&search=john&role=CUSTOMER&status=ACTIVE&verified=true&sort=createdAt&order=desc
```

**Searchable Fields:** Full Name, Email, Phone Number, User ID
**Filter Fields:** role, status, verified, startDate, endDate

item.name: Get All Users (Paginated, Searchable, Filterable)
item.description:
Fetch all users with full pagination, search, filter, and sort support.

**Example URLs:**
- `GET /admin/users?page=1&limit=20`
- `GET /admin/users?search=john`
- `GET /admin/users?role=CUSTOMER`
- `GET /admin/users?status=ACTIVE`
- `GET /admin/users?role=RIDER&status=SUSPENDED`
- `GET /admin/users?verified=true`
- `GET /admin/users?sort=createdAt&order=desc`
- `GET /admin/users?startDate=2026-07-01&endDate=2026-07-31`

query.description: Full name, email, phone, user ID

request.description:
Returns daily revenue totals for the last 14 days (inclusive of today).
Only counts orders in DELIVERED status.

**Auth:** Admin only — requires Bearer token.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "period": { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD" },
  "totalRevenue": <number — sum over 14 days>,
  "peakDay": { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "revenue": <number> },
  "days": [
    { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "revenue": <number> },
    ...
  ]
}
```

item.name: 🏦 SafeHaven API (Direct)
item.description:
Direct calls to the SafeHaven MFB API (sandbox). These bypass the PickAm gateway and call SafeHaven directly. Requires SafeHaven OAuth token.

Sandbox Base URL: https://api.sandbox.safehavenmfb.com
Production Base URL: https://api.safehavenmfb.com
